```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)
library(hexbin)
```

The data comes from the `openintro` package. The dataset is called `loans_full_schema`.

```{r}
#| label: glimpse

glimpse(loans_full_schema)
```

There are `r nrow(loans_full_schema)` observations in the dataset and `r ncol(loans_full_schema)` variables. We are only interested in 8 of those variables.

```{r}
#| label: select fields

loans <- loans_full_schema %>%
  select(loan_amount, interest_rate, term, grade, state, annual_income, homeownership, debt_to_income)
glimpse(loans)
```

## Histograms

```{r}
#| label: histogram-1

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of the loan amount", subtitle = "Binwidth: auto")
```

```{r}
#| label: histogram-2

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5000) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of the loan amount", subtitle = "Binwidth: 5,000")

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10000) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of the loan amount", subtitle = "Binwidth: 10,000")

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 15000) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of the loan amount", subtitle = "Binwidth: 15,000")

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 20000) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of the loan amount", subtitle = "Binwidth: 20,000")
```

### Final plot with labels

```{r}
#| label: final-histogram

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount, fill = homeownership)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5000, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Amounts of lending club loans", 
       subtitle = "Binwidth: 5,000",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         loan_amount = "Loan amount ($)",
         count = "Frequency",
         homeownership = "Homeownership"))

```

### Faceted histogram

```{r}
#| label: faceted-histogram

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount, fill = homeownership)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5000) +
  labs(title = "Amounts of lending club loans", 
       subtitle = "Binwidth: 5,000",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         loan_amount = "Loan amount ($)",
         count = "Frequency",
         homeownership = "Homeownership")) +
  facet_wrap(~ homeownership, nrow = 3) + 
  guides(fill = FALSE)

```

### Density plots

```{r}
#| label: density-plot

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount)) +
  geom_density() +
  labs(title = "Amounts of lending club loans", 
       subtitle = "Smoothness: auto",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         loan_amount = "Loan amount ($)",
         density = "Density",
         homeownership = "Homeownership"))

```

```{r}
#| label: density-plot-2

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2) +
  labs(title = "Amounts of lending club loans", 
       subtitle = "Smoothness: 2",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         loan_amount = "Loan amount ($)",
         density = "Density",
         homeownership = "Homeownership"))

```

```{r}
#| label: density-plot-3

ggplot(loans, aes(x = loan_amount, fill = homeownership)) +
  geom_density(adjust = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Amounts of lending club loans", 
       subtitle = "Smoothness: 2",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         loan_amount = "Loan amount ($)",
         density = "Density",
         homeownership = "Homeownership"))

```

## Box plots

```{r}
#| label: box-plot-1

ggplot(loans, aes(x = annual_income)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot of annual income", 
       # subtitle = "Subtitle",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         annual_income = "Annual income ($)")) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank()
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: box-plot-2

ggplot(loans, aes(x = interest_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot of interest rates", 
       # subtitle = "Subtitle",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         interest_rate = "Interest rate")) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank()
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: box-plot-3

ggplot(loans, aes(x = interest_rate, y = grade)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot of interest rates", 
      subtitle = "By grade of loan",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         interest_rate = "Interest rate (%)",
         grade = "Grade of loan")) 
```

## Instead of a scatter plots

```{r}
#| label: scatter-plot

ggplot(loans, aes(x = debt_to_income, y = interest_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Scatter plot of interest rates and debt to income ratio", 
      #subtitle = "---",
       caption = "Source: openintro R ackage",
       dictionary = c(
         interest_rate = "Interest rate (%)",
         debt_to_income = "Debt to income")) 
```

```{r}
#| label: hex-plot


ggplot(loans, aes(x = debt_to_income, y = interest_rate)) +
  geom_hex()
```

```{r}
#| label: hex-plot-filtered

ggplot(loans %>% filter(debt_to_income < 100), aes(x = debt_to_income, y = interest_rate)) +
  geom_hex()
```
